header.supersessionBasis: CP-001 governed change package — repository binding and OD-01 disposition

boundFrameworkVersion: PAF v0.x (construction baseline; final bind at Step 55 freeze)

terminology.industryAgnostic: The platform serves multi-industry clients with diverse processes and vocabularies. All language must reflect this.
prohibitedFramings: SMB wholesale distribution as a target vertical or beachhead — a misconception from a prototype dataset, never to be reintroduced
P2P/O2C as a primary process focus
terminology.retainedPositioning: Customer size positioning (mid-market / SMB) is correct and retained.
terminology.productClass: Process Intelligence as a Service (PIaaS) — multi-tenant, process- and industry-agnostic
terminology.clientModel: Clients bring their own event logs and processes.

productConstraints.multiTenant: Multi-tenant; tenant isolation is a global non-waivable invariant
productConstraints.mvpIsFunctionalSubset: MVP delivers a functional subset; the DESIGN must accommodate all functionality through every post-MVP requirement so no redesign or data migration is ever needed to activate later features
productConstraints.designAheadPrinciple: DDR P-8 / no-migration: deferring functionality is permitted; deferring design that accumulated state will later require is not

buildSequenceNote: RICE sequencing ranks discretionary items on a completed foundation; foundation/infrastructure is sequenced by dependency, not RICE.

tenantSecurityConstraints.tenantIsolation: Every canonical data access path scoped to a tenant boundary; isolation that cannot be demonstrated is a violation

noMigrationRules.cutLineRule: The cut line moves through features, never through design. 'Not in MVP' means not operational yet, never not designed for.
noMigrationRules.designAheadTax: Deferred features carry a small non-zero design line item above the cut line; deferred is never free.

documentTimestampRule: All ProjectOne document timestamps must be to-the-minute in local Eastern time (America/New_York), not UTC.
provenanceTaggingRule: When a Historical Files Reconciliation finding drives a canon/documentation edit, append a parenthetical provenance note including the finding ID wherever the finding lands.

githubExecutionModel.description: Owner executes all GitHub operations. The assistant produces exact commands and expected output; the owner runs them and returns actual output, which becomes the evidence record.
githubExecutionModel.rationale: Keeps credentials and secrets entirely off the assistant platform. secret_protection is a global non-waivable invariant, so this is handled by architecture rather than by exception.
githubExecutionModel.consequence: Steps 63-72, 91, 101 and 110 are owner-executed. No GitHub result is recorded as passing unless the owner actually ran it and returned output.
